blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As Filipino families return home after traveling to their respective provinces and visiting cemeteries to honor departed loved ones during Undas, Manila Water is encouraging customers to attend to household sanitation by availing themselves of the company’s scheduled desludging services this November. With families settling back into their regular routines, customers are reminded to check the condition of their septic tanks and ensure that these are properly maintained. Regular desludging helps prevent septic tanks from overflowing, producing foul odors, and contaminating surrounding areas and waterways.
